title.narrative: Menace explosive au Burkina Faso – éducation aux risques des communautés et sensibilisation des humanitaires

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide protection (mine action) assistance to 21,582 affected people. This UNOPS project aims to provide access to humanitarian actors to the most vulnerable populations by reducing the dangers associated with explosive devices when assistance is delivered. The project provides life-saving assistance to 21,582 people, including 6,724 women, 6,612 men, 8,516 children and 336 people with disabilities.
